ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce ransomware pre-encryption recovery sabotage chain (vssadmin → wmic → bcdedit → wbadmin)
ucs.description: Detects the canonical DragonForce (Conti/LockBit-derived RaaS, Malaysia-linked criminal crew behind the 2025 M&S/Co-op/Harrods intrusions) destruction-readiness chain: shadow-copy wipe, boot recovery disablement, and backup-catalog deletion within minutes — fired by the same user/host before the ransomware EXE detonates.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd_lines values(Processes.process_name) as binaries dc(Processes.process_name) as distinct_tactics from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where ((Processes.process_name="vssadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*shadows*") OR (Processes.process_name="wmic.exe" AND Processes.process="*shadowcopy*delete*") OR (Processes.process_name="bcdedit.exe" AND (Processes.process="*recoveryenabled*no*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*")) OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*catalog*") OR (Processes.process_name="wbadmin.exe" AND Processes.process="*delete*backup*") OR (Processes.process_name="net.exe" AND Processes.process="*stop*" AND (Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*SQLWriter*" OR Processes.process="*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*MSExchange*"))) by Processes.dest Processes.user _time span=10m | where distinct_tactics >= 2 AND NOT match(Processes.user, ".*\\$$") | rename Processes.* as * | sort - firstTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend Tactic = case(
    FileName =~ "vssadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "vss_wipe",
    FileName =~ "wmic.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "shadowcopy" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete", "wmic_shadow_wipe",
    FileName =~ "bcdedit.exe" and (ProcessCommandLine has_all ("recoveryenabled","no") or ProcessCommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures")), "bcd_recovery_disable",
    FileName =~ "wbadmin.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "delete" and (ProcessCommandLine has "catalog" or ProcessCommandLine has "backup"), "wbadmin_purge",
    FileName =~ "net.exe" and ProcessCommandLine has "stop" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Veeam","SQLWriter","MSSQL","BackupExec","MSExchange","Acronis","VSS"), "backup_svc_stop",
    "")
| where Tactic != ""
| summarize Tactics = make_set(Tactic), DistinctTactics = dcount(Tactic),
            First = min(Timestamp), Last = max(Timestamp),
            SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName, 10)
    by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where DistinctTactics >= 2     // chain, not isolated admin task — empirical FP cutoff
| order by First desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
| where EventID == 4688
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend Bin = tolower(tostring(extract(@"\\([^\\]+\.exe)$", 1, NewProcessName)))
| extend Tactic = case(
    Bin == "vssadmin.exe" and CommandLine has_all ("delete","shadows"), "vss_wipe",
    Bin == "wmic.exe" and CommandLine has "shadowcopy" and CommandLine has "delete", "wmic_shadow_wipe",
    Bin == "bcdedit.exe" and (CommandLine has_all ("recoveryenabled","no") or CommandLine has_all ("bootstatuspolicy","ignoreallfailures")), "bcd_recovery_disable",
    Bin == "wbadmin.exe" and CommandLine has "delete" and (CommandLine has "catalog" or CommandLine has "backup"), "wbadmin_purge",
    Bin == "net.exe" and CommandLine has "stop" and CommandLine has_any ("Veeam","SQLWriter","MSSQL","BackupExec","MSExchange","Acronis","VSS"), "backup_svc_stop",
    "")
| where Tactic != ""
| summarize Tactics = make_set(Tactic), DistinctTactics = dcount(Tactic),
            First = min(TimeGenerated), Last = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleCmds = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            Binaries = make_set(Bin, 10)
    by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where DistinctTactics >= 2
| order by First desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\\vssadmin.exe OR *\\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\\VSSADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"Delete Shadows"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wmic.exe OR *\\WMIC.exe OR *\\WMIC.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*shadowcopy* AND *delete*)) OR (@Image:(*\\bcdedit.exe OR *\\BCDEdit.exe OR *\\BCDEDIT.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"recoveryenabled no"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\wbadmin.exe OR *\\WBAdmin.exe OR *\\WBADMIN.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*"delete catalog"* OR *"delete backup"*)) OR (@Image:(*\\net.exe OR *\\Net.exe OR *\\NET.EXE) AND @CommandLine:(*stop* AND (*Veeam* OR *SQLWriter* OR *MSSQL* OR *BackupExec* OR *MSExchange* OR *Acronis*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wmic|bcdedit|wbadmin|net)\.exe$/i
| (regex("delete\\s+shadows", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR regex("shadowcopy\\s+delete", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR regex("recoveryenabled\\s+no", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR regex("bootstatuspolicy\\s+ignoreallfailures", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR regex("delete\\s+(catalog|backup)", field=CommandLine, flags="i") OR regex("stop\\s+\"?(Veeam|SQLWriter|MSSQL|BackupExec|MSExchange|Acronis|VSS)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName], function=[count(as=hits), collect([ImageFileName]), collect([CommandLine])])
| hits >= 2
ucs.rationale: DragonForce's affiliate playbook (inherited from LockBit Black + Conti v3 builders they re-skinned) burns recovery infrastructure in a tight sequence seconds before the encryptor runs — operators have been observed scripting all four commands plus backup-service kills into a single deployment batch (`run.bat` / Cobalt Strike `execute-assembly` chain). A single vssadmin invocation is normal admin n

ucs.title: [LLM] DragonForce BYOVD vulnerable-driver drop preceding LSASS credential dump
ucs.description: Detects DragonForce's pre-lateral-movement EDR-blinding pattern — write of a known signed-but-vulnerable kernel driver (TrueSight, RentDrv2, GMER, MHYPROT2, ProcExp152, etc.) to disk on a host, followed within hours by an LSASS minidump file being written under the same DeviceId. This combo featured in the 2025 M&S/Co-op intrusions attributed to the DragonForce affiliate ecosystem.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as driver_time values(Filesystem.file_path) as driver_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as driver_dropper from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","aswarpot.sys","kapuser.sys","procexp152.sys","gmer64.sys","gmer.sys","gdrv.sys","viragt64.sys","ene.sys","mhyprot2.sys","rwdrv.sys","amifldrv64.sys","atillk64.sys","msio64.sys","procexp.sys","dbutil_2_3.sys","rtcore64.sys") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.file_name | rename Filesystem.dest as dest | join type=inner dest [ | tstats summariesonly=true min(_time) as dump_time values(Filesystem.file_path) as dump_path values(Filesystem.process_name) as dump_proc values(Filesystem.process) as dump_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_name="*.dmp" OR Filesystem.file_name="lsass*") AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Public\\*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\AppData\\*") by Filesystem.dest | rename Filesystem.dest as dest ] | eval delay_min=round((dump_time - driver_time)/60, 1) | where delay_min >= -60 AND delay_min <= 360 | table driver_time, dump_time, delay_min, dest, driver_path, dump_path, dump_proc, dump_cmd | sort - driver_time
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let VulnerableDrivers = dynamic([
    "truesight.sys","rentdrv2.sys","aswarpot.sys","kapuser.sys","procexp152.sys",
    "gmer64.sys","gmer.sys","gdrv.sys","viragt64.sys","ene.sys","mhyprot2.sys",
    "rwdrv.sys","amifldrv64.sys","atillk64.sys","msio64.sys","procexp.sys",
    "dbutil_2_3.sys","rtcore64.sys","zam64.sys"]);
let DriverDrops = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileRenamed")
    | where tolower(FileName) in (VulnerableDrivers)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("MsMpEng.exe","TiWorker.exe","TrustedInstaller.exe")     // exclude defender + servicing stack
    | project DriverTime = Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName,
              DriverFile = FileName, DriverPath = FolderPath,
              DriverDropper = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DropperCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DropperUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let LsassDumps = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where (FileName endswith ".dmp" or FileName startswith "lsass" or FileName has "sekurlsa")
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Temp\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\Public\", @"\AppData\", @"\Windows\Tasks\", @"\PerfLogs\")
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("lsass","procdump","comsvcs","MiniDump","sekurlsa","-ma ")
        or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("procdump.exe","procdump64.exe","rundll32.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | project DumpTime = Timestamp, DeviceId,
              DumpFile = FileName, DumpPath = FolderPath,
              DumpInitiator = InitiatingProcessFileName,
              DumpCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              DumpUser = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
DriverDrops
| join kind=inner LsassDumps on DeviceId
| where DumpTime between (DriverTime - 1h .. DriverTime + 6h)     // 6h forward window — affiliate ops often pause between blinding + dumping
| project DriverTime, DumpTime,
          DelayMin = datetime_diff('minute', DumpTime, DriverTime),
          DeviceName, DriverFile, DriverPath, DriverDropper, DropperCmd, DropperUser,
          DumpFile, DumpPath, DumpInitiator, DumpCmd, DumpUser
| order by DriverTime desc

ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:(*\\truesight.sys OR *\\TrueSight.sys OR *\\TRUESIGHT.SYS OR *\\rentdrv2.sys OR *\\RentDrv2.sys OR *\\RENTDRV2.SYS OR *\\aswarpot.sys OR *\\kapuser.sys OR *\\procexp152.sys OR *\\ProcExp152.sys OR *\\gmer64.sys OR *\\gmer.sys OR *\\GMER.sys OR *\\gdrv.sys OR *\\mhyprot2.sys OR *\\MHYPROT2.sys OR *\\rwdrv.sys OR *\\rtcore64.sys OR *\\RTCore64.sys OR *\\dbutil_2_3.sys OR *\\zam64.sys)) -@Image:(*\\TrustedInstaller.exe OR *\\MsMpEng.exe OR *\\TiWorker.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\(truesight|rentdrv2|aswarpot|kapuser|procexp152|gmer64|gmer|gdrv|viragt64|ene|mhyprot2|rwdrv|amifldrv64|atillk64|msio64|procexp|dbutil_2_3|rtcore64|zam64)\.sys$/i
| NOT (ContextImageFileName=/\\(TrustedInstaller|MsMpEng|TiWorker)\.exe$/i)
| join({#event_simpleName=FileWritten
        | TargetFileName=/(\.dmp$|^lsass|sekurlsa)/i
        | TargetFileName=/\\(Temp|ProgramData|Public|AppData|PerfLogs)\\/i
        | (ContextImageFileName=/\\(procdump|procdump64|rundll32|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i OR regex("(lsass|procdump|comsvcs|MiniDump|sekurlsa|\\s-ma\\s)", field=CommandLine, flags="i"))
        | DumpTime := @timestamp
        | DumpFile := TargetFileName
        | DumpProc := ContextImageFileName
      }, field=aid, include=[DumpTime, DumpFile, DumpProc])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, TargetFileName, DumpFile, DumpProc], function=[min(@timestamp, as=DriverTime), min(DumpTime, as=DumpTime)])
